title: Provide canonical identities, aliases, and relationships for runtime discovery
description:
Provide pack-side stable identities, aliases, topics, and many-to-many relationships
that help runtime discovery find potentially governing material without exact kind/title
lookup. Do not make this a universal search-completeness requirement. Relationships are
discovery reasons, not exclusive ownership.
acceptance_criteria:
- Known duplicate names and represented option identities resolve to stable unambiguous identities.
- Runtime discovery can consume aliases/topics/relationships without exact normalized kind/title.
- Relationship metadata preserves multiple meaningful retrieval reasons rather than exclusive neighborhoods.
- A demonstrated missing alias/index entry can be a discovery defect; absence from an index never proves irrelevance or source absence.
- This bead makes no universal retrieval-completeness claim.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
